goal_and_scope: Transfer a conditional CTMC safe-pulse result, structural timing obstruction, selective prior-art boundary, and prospective falsification design for cell-state regeneration/partial reprogramming.
acquired_inputs: primary protocol/outcome records for partial reprogramming and cardiomyocyte regeneration
representation_and_assumptions: Homogeneous fixed-dose CTMC S->R (a), S->U (c), R->U (b); target occupancy at pulse stop; U absorbing; context-specific rates.
exact_missing_lemma: An experimentally measured, uncertainty-bounded state-transition generator for a named cell type/context/delivery protocol, including joint target and harm states, is missing; the mathematical pulse duration is conditional until this is acquired.
comparator: Training-selected best open-loop schedule at matched measured factor exposure and delivery cost, tested on held-out animals/donors.
falsifier_or_next_experiment: Measure same-cell lineage and target/harm transitions plus intracellular OSK/OSKM protein trajectories in one fixed context; test withheld-duration predictions and reject CTMC if holding-time or calibration tests fail.
status_note: Conditional mathematical result and interface critique; no data-based biological controller or safety guarantee.
